$$
{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA={∬}_{Δ}\,f(r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta )\,r\,dr\,d\theta .

$$
\Delta=\{(r,\theta):0\leq r\leq 2 \sqrt{7},\ 0\leq\theta\leq 2 \pi\}.
$$

Therefore, using the change of variables formula, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}+1)\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{Δ}\operatorname{ln}⁡((r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta )^{2}+(r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta )^{2}+1)r\,\text{d}r\,\text{d}\theta  \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2\pi }{\int }_{0}^{2 \sqrt{7}}r\operatorname{ln}⁡({r}^{2}({cos}^{2}⁡\theta +{sin}^{2}⁡\theta )+1)\text{d}r\,\text{d}\theta  \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2\pi }{\int }_{0}^{2 \sqrt{7}}r\operatorname{ln}⁡({r}^{2}+1)\,\text{d}r\,\text{d}\theta .\end{aligned}
$$
